method: startup A/B: the shell is restarted with the enabled set minus every audited plugin (baseline) and with that set plus one plugin; after listPlugins answers and a settle, VmRSS at the end of the window and utime+stime over the window are read from /proc for the shell pid; descendants are sampled once a second; each plugin row is the median over runs of (plus minus baseline, run by run) with the spread (max minus min); a delta whose absolute median is not above the baseline spread is within noise

plugins.name: Plugin Manager

withinNoise.note: rss and cpu compare the median delta with the baseline spread; ownRss and ownCpu compare it with the spread of its own three deltas

plugins.origin: rent-audit: /proc/<shell pid>/status VmRSS and /proc/<shell pid>/stat utime+stime, plus minus baseline per run; children from /proc descendant sampling
